headline: Payment of $27,530 to Western & Sampson for Eastern Waste Site peer review, and $510,910 in FEMA grant funds.
summary: Other items include a LAND Grant of up to $425,000 for the Magnolia Reserve conservation project and an $11,200 CVA Grant. The agenda also covers a three-year snow and ice amortization schedule and accounts spending more than they were authorized.
items: Adopt the 3-year snow and ice amortization schedule

CITY CLERK GLOUCESTER, MA 2026 NOV 12 AM 8:30

# GLOUCESTER CITY COUNCIL

**Budget & Finance Committee Meeting**

**Thursday, November 19, 2026 – 5:30 p.m.**

**City Hall**

**1st Floor Council Conference Room**

**9 Dale Avenue, Gloucester, MA 01930**

The public is welcome to attend in person. Zoom link to access the meeting remotely is also available.

Join from Computer, Smart Device: https://gloucester-ma-gov.zoom.us/j/85991268257

Join via Phone: 1 305 224 1968 or 1 309 205 3325

Meeting ID: 859 9126 8257

*Please note that the in-person meeting will not be suspended or terminated if technological problems interrupt the remote connection.*

## AGENDA

Individual items from committee reports may be consolidated into a consent agenda

1. Memorandum from the City Auditor regarding adoption of the 3-year Snow & Ice Amortization Schedule.
2. Memorandum from the Interim Police Chief requesting acceptance of a donation in the amount of $100 from the Massachusetts Elks Association to support any CIU program.
3. Memorandum from the General Counsel requesting approval to pay FY2026 invoices with FY2027 funds in the amount of $210 for the Registry of Deeds.
4. Memorandum from the General Counsel requesting approval to pay FY2026 invoices with FY2027 funds in the amount of $27,530 from Western & Sampson for peer review services re: Board of Health Eastern Waste Site Assignment Application.
5. Memorandum from the Director of Public Works requesting acceptance of the revised FEMA Public Assistance Grant in the amount of $510,910.
6. Memorandum from the Planning Director requesting acceptance of the LAND Grant award for the Magnolia Reserve Conservation project in the amount up to $425,000
7. Memorandum from the Harbormaster requesting acceptance of the 2025 CVA Grant in the amount of $11,200
8. Memorandum from the City Auditor regarding accounts having expenditures which exceed their authorization & Auditor's Report and other related business

**B&F COMMITTEE**

**Chair, Councilor Scott Memhard**

**Vice Chair, Councilor Tony Gross**

**Councilor, Patti-Ann Page**

CC: Mayor Paul Lundberg; Kelly Dolan; Grace E. Poirier; Kenny Costa; Michael Gossom; Suzanne Egan; Michael Hale; Gregg Cademartori; Chris Lucido

The listing of matters is those reasonably anticipated by the Chair which may be discussed at the meeting. Not all items listed may be discussed & other items not listed may also be brought up for discussion to the extent permitted by law. Items may be taken out of order.
